name: Paperless-ngx
short_description: Self-hosted document management system with OCR. for home.
description: Paperless-ngx is a community-supported open-source document management system that transforms your physical documents into a searchable online archive. It uses OCR to make scanned documents fully searchable and organizes everything with tags, correspondents, and document types.
usecases: Scan and archive paper documents with automatic OCR.
Search and retrieve any document instantly by content.
Organize documents with tags, types, and correspondents.
